 At Jabalpur

sentences.text: In the present case, an adjustment note has been filed by Shri Brijendra Swaroop Sahu.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner on the application for grant of stay.

The present petition has been filed for quashment of FIR No. 80/2018 registered at Police Station Raisen under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, as well as the charge sheet filed in Sessions Trial No. 165/2020 pending before the Court of the Additional Sessions Judge, Raisen.

entities.text: Court of the Additional Sessions Judge, Raisen
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that after completion of the investigation, the police prepared a closure report (Khatma Report) (Annexure-P/1) dated 11.06.2018 and sought legal opinion from the prosecution department on 08.06.2018; however, thereafter, the police filed the charge sheet.
It is further submitted that the complainant has lodged nearly 20 private complaints alleging the same facts and allegations against different persons.

It is also submitted that, 2 MCRC-48696-2020 as per the complaint, the offence has been registered on the basis of an agreement to sell; however, according to the handwriting expert's report, the signature of the petitioner is not found on the said agreement.

Considering the aforesaid submissions and the allegations contained in the charge sheet, further proceedings in Sessions Trial No. 165/2020 pending before the Additional Sessions Judge, Raisen,
shall remain stayed.

(B. P. SHARMA) JUDGE SM Laxmi Narayan Patidar vs The State Of M.P. on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183479513/
